pages.title: Spirit Realm Continent
pages.text: This entry follows patchouli_static_entries.json#spirit_fengyuan, region_cards/spirit_fengyuan.json, and human_clan_league.json. The spirit_fengyuan region is available in current world data, requires Deity Transformation, and uses fengyuan_anchor for travel.

pages.title: Current Data
pages.text: Fengyuan Continent has a 1.8 aura multiplier and the tags spirit_realm, clans, and treasure_fair. Its Human Clan League, coexistence with demon clans, and northern border with the Wilds remain guide context and future quest hooks.

pages.title: Clans and Secret Realms
pages.text: The Fengyuan Human Clan League includes the formation-specialist Mo Clan, refinement-specialist Yu Clan, alchemy-specialist Gu Clan, and talisman-specialist Ning Clan. Existing secret-realm hooks include the Earth Abyss, Devil-Gold Mountains, Lesser Asura Realm, and Nine Immortals Mountain retreat.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: Clan NPCs, clan reputation, the league quest network, treasure-fair bidding, Wilds border access, specialty shops, and the playable Fengyuan exploration route are not yet implemented. The corresponding native routes are projected in the FTB Quests chapter 'Spirit Realm: Tianyuan and the Fengyuan Clans'; native progress remains authoritative. This page describes only existing region, secret-realm, and event clues.
